P1790 ST Solenoid Valve Circuit Malfunction DTC
CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION
Shift solenoid valve ST is switched ON-OFF by a signal from ECM so that let in or out timing of 2nd brake
is adjusted by operating orifice control valve. Therefore, ST solenoid operates when letting in or out reverse
clutch.
If it is broken, the shift shock becomes big.
